Controls help

Left thumb anywhere on the left half: a stick appears there. Push to roll and climb or dive, let go and it springs back. Right edge: the throttle, slide it or tap IDLE, CLIMB, FULL. BRAKE above it, hold on the ground. Top right: Auto takes off or lands for you, then gear, flaps and camera. Pause is top centre. Tap the grade badge after a landing to see the details.

Arrows or W A S D
Fly. Easy: let go and it levels out
Mouse or trackpad
Click and drag on the scene like a yoke. Scroll for throttle
Shift, Control
Throttle up, down (R and F also work)
1 2 3
Throttle idle, climb, full
O
Smart auto: takes off on the ground, lands in the air
Space
Brakes (hold)
C P M T
Camera, pause, all sound, radio
G ] [ Y H
Gear, flaps, trim
Controller
Left stick flies, triggers throttle, A auto, B brakes, Y camera, X gear, bumpers flaps
